والجان خلقنه من قبل من نار السموم
dhe perkujto kur zoti yt engjejve u tha une po krijoi njeriun nga balta e thare e zeze e me ere
and mention o muhammad when your lord said to the angels i will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud
واذ قال ربك للمليكه اني خلق بشر ا من صلصل من حما مسنون‏
e kur ta persose ate ne formen e njeriut dhe do t i jape atij shpirtin qe eshte krijesa imja atehere ju bini atij ne sexhde
and when i have proportioned him and breathed into him of my created soul then fall down to him in prostration
فاذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له سجدين
te gjithe engjejt tok bene sexhde
so the angels prostrated all of them entirely
فسجد المليكه كلهم اجمعون
perpos iblisit ai refuzoi te jete me ata qe bene sexhde
except iblees he refused to be with those who prostrated
الا ابليس ابي ان يكون مع السجدين
ai tha o iblis c eshte ajo qe ti mos jehse me ata qe bene sexhde
allah said o iblees what is the matter with you that you are not with those who prostrate
قال يابليس ما لك الا تكون مع السجدين
ai tha nuk eshte per mua t i beje sexhde nje njeriu qe e krijove nga balta e terur e zeze e me ere
he said never would i prostrate to a human whom you created out of clay from an altered black mud
قال لم اكن لاسجد لبشر خلقته من صلصل من حما مسنون‏
all llahu tha dil pra prej aty tiqofsh i mallkuar
allah said then get out of it for indeed you are expelled
قال فاخرج منها فانك رجيم‏
vertet mallkimi kunder teje qofte deri ne diten e gjykimit
and indeed upon you is the curse until the day of recompense
وان عليك اللعنه الي يوم الدين
iblisi tha zoti im me jep afat deri ne diten kur ata njerezit te ringjallen
he said my lord then reprieve me until the day they are resurrected
قال رب فانظرني الي يوم يبعثون
zoti tha ti je prej te afatizuarve
allah said so indeed you are of those reprieved
قال فانك من المنظرين
deri ne kohen e dites se caktuar
until the day of the time well known
الي يوم الوقت المعلوم
iblisi tha zoti im per shkak qe me perzune me largove une do t ua zbukuroje te keqiat atyre sa te jene ne toke ne kete bote dhe te gjithe ata do t i largoje nga rruga e drejte
iblees said my lord because you have put me in error i will surely make disobedience attractive to them on earth and i will mislead them all
قال رب بما اغويتني لازينن لهم في الارض ولاغوينهم اجمعين
pervec roberve te tu te cilet i ke bere te sinqerte
except among them your chosen servants
الا عبادك منهم المخلصين
madheria e tij tha kjo eshte rruga ime e drejte e qarte
allah said this is a path of return to me that is straight
قال هذا صرط علي مستقيم
se ndaj robeve te mi te sinqerte nuk ke kurrefare force as fizike as mendore pervec atyre te humburve qe vijne pas teje
indeed my servants no authority will you have over them except those who follow you of the deviators
ان عبادي ليس لك عليهم سلطن الا من اتبعك من الغاوين
e s ka dyshim se xhehennemi eshte vendpremtimi i te gjithe atyre
and indeed hell is the promised place for them all
وان جهنم لموعدهم اجمعين
ai xhehennemi i ka shtate dyer cdonjeri prej tyre ka shtegun deren e caktuar neper te cilen do te hyje
it has seven gates for every gate is of them a portion designated
لها سبعه ابوب لكل باب منهم جزء مقسوم
e ata te cilet iu ruajten mosbesimit dhe puneve te keqija jane ne xhennete e mes burimeve
indeed the righteous will be within gardens and springs
ان المتقين في جنت وعيون
u thuhet hyni ne to te shpetuar prej cdo te keqeje te siguruar nga vdekja
having been told enter it in peace safe and secure
ادخلوها بسلم ءامنين
ne kemi hequr prej zemrave te tyre cfardo urrejtje e at ne mbeshtetese qendrojne balle per balle njeri tjetrit duke qene te vellazeruar
and we will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment so they will be brothers on thrones facing each other
ونزعنا ما في صدورهم من غل اخونا علي سرر متقبلين
ata aty nuk igodet kurrfare lodhje dhe nuk do te nxirren kurre prej tij
no fatigue will touch them therein nor from it will they ever be removed
لا يمسهم فيها نصب وما هم منها بمخرجين
njoftoi robet e mi se vertet une jam ai qe fal shume dhe meshirues i madh
o muhammad inform my servants that it is i who am the forgiving the merciful
نبي عبادي اني انا الغفور الرحيم
po njoftoje se edhe denimi im eshte ai i dhembshem
and that it is my punishment which is the painful punishment
وان عذابي هو العذاب الاليم
enjoftoj edhe per mysafiret e ibrahimit
and inform them about the guests of abraham
ونبيهم عن ضيف ابرهيم
kur ata hyne te ai dhe thane selamen e pershendeten e ai ibrahimi tha ne po frikesohemi prej jush
when they entered upon him and said peace abraham said indeed we are fearful of you
اذ دخلوا عليه فقالوا سلم ا قال انا منكم وجلون
ata thane mos u frikeso ne po te marrim myzhde per nje djale te zgjuar
the angels said fear not indeed we give you good tidings of a learned boy
قالوا لا توجل انا نبشرك بغلم عليم‏
ai ibrahimi tha a me merrni myzhde kur me ka kapur mua pleqeria me cka po me pergezoni ju
he said have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me then of what wonder do you inform
قال ابشرتموني علي ان مسني الكبر فبم تبشرون
ata thane ne te morem myzhde me ate qe eshte e sigurte e ti mos u be i pashprese
they said we have given you good tidings in truth so do not be of the despairing
قالوا بشرنك بالحق فلا تكن من القنطين
tha askush nuk e humb shpresen ne meshiren e zotit te vet pervec atyre qe jane te humbur
he said and who despairs of the mercy of his lord except for those astray
قال ومن يقنط من رحمه ربه الا الضالون
tha e cka eshte pra ceshtja e juaj o te derguar
abraham said then what is your business here o messengers
قال فما خطبكم ايها المرسلون
ata thane ne jemi derguar te nje popull i prishur
they said indeed we have been sent to a people of criminals
قالوا انا ارسلنا الي قوم مجرمين
me perjashtim te familjes se lutit ata do t i shpetojme qe te gjithe
except the family of lot indeed we will save them all
الا ءال لوط انا لمنجوهم اجمعين
perpos gruas setij ne kemi vendosur ajo te mbetet me ata te denuarit all llahu ka vendosur
except his wife allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind
الا امراته قدرنا انها لمن الغبرين
e kur i erdhen familjes se lutit te derguarit
and when the messengers came to the family of lot
فلما جاء ءال لوط المرسلون
ai luti tha ju jeni njerez te panjohur nuk ju njoh
he said indeed you are people unknown
قال انكم قوم منكرون
ata thane jo nuk kemi qellim te keq ndaj teje te kemi ardhur ty me ate denim qe ata dyshonin
they said but we have come to you with that about which they were disputing
قالوا بل جينك بما كانوا فيه يمترون
te kemi sjelle te verteten e ne jemi te drejte cka themi
and we have come to you with truth and indeed we are truthful
واتينك بالحق وانا لصدقون
ti ec me familjen tende pasi te kaloje nje pjese e nates dhe rri pas tyre qe te mos frkesohen dhe asnjeri prej jush te mos ktheje mbrapa per te shikuar dhe shkoni andej kah urdheroheni
so set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded
فاسر باهلك بقطع من اليل واتبع ادبرهم ولا يلتفت منكم احد وامضوا حيث تومرون
e ne i kumtuam atij lutit ate ceshtje se zhdukja e tyre deri ne me te mbramin do te jete ne mengjes
and we conveyed to him the decree of that matter that those sinners would be eliminated by early morning
وقضينا اليه ذلك الامر ان دابر هولاء مقطوع مصبحين
e banuesit e qytetit sadum erdhen te gezuar duke i lajmeruar njeri tjetrin
and the people of the city came rejoicing
وجاء اهل المدينه يستبشرون
tha luti keta jane mysafiret e mi e mos me turperoni mua
lot said indeed these are my guests so do not shame me
قال ان هولاء ضيفي فلا تفضحون
edhe kinie frike all llahun e mos me nencmoni
and fear allah and do not disgrace me
واتقوا الله ولا تخزون
ata thane a nuk te kemi ndaluar qe te mos na perzihesh ne njerezit qe ne i mesyjme
they said have we not forbidden you from protecting people
قالوا اولم ننهك عن العلمين
ai luti tha ja keto grate bijat e mija nese do te beni martohuni me to
lot said these are my daughters if you would be doers of lawful marriage
قال هولاء بناتي ان كنتم فعلين
pasha jeten tende muhammed s ka dyshim se ata populli i lutit ishin te humbur ne dehjen e tyre
by your life o muhammad indeed they were in their intoxication wandering blindly
لعمرك انهم لفي سكرتهم يعمهون
e ne kohen e lindjes se diellit ata i perfshiu ushtima e tmerrshme
so the shriek seized them at sunrise
فاخذتهم الصيحه مشرقين
dhe duke e permbysur anen e larte te qytetit poshte ne e permbysem dhe leshuammbi ta shi te dheut te pjekur ne xhehennem si gure
and we made the highest part of the city its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay
فجعلنا عليها سافلها وامطرنا عليهم حجاره من سجيل
ne ate ngjarje vertet ka argumente per ata qe mendojne
indeed in that are signs for those who discern
ان في ذلك لايت للمتوسمين
dhe se ato vendbanime te shkaterruara ende jane te dukshme prane rruges
and indeed those cities are situated on an established road
وانها لبسبيل مقيم
per ata qe besojne ka fakte ne te
indeed in that is a sign for the believers
ان في ذلك لايه للمومنين
edhe populli i ejkes ishin zullumqare
and the companions of the thicket were also wrongdoers
وان كان اصحب الايكه لظلمين
e ne nderrmorem kunder tyre i shkaterruam dhe qe te dyja ato vendi sadum dhe ejke jane ne rruge qe duken
so we took retribution from them and indeed both cities are on a clear highway
فانتقمنا منهم وانهما لبامام مبين‏
edhe populli i hixhres i pergenjeshtroi te derguarit
and certainly did the companions of thamud deny the messengers
ولقد كذب اصحب الحجر المرسلين
ne u patem parashtruar atyre mrekullite tona por ata i kundershtonin ato
and we gave them our signs but from them they were turning away
وءاتينهم ءايتنا فكانوا عنها معرضين
ata skalisnin shtepia ne kodra shkembore per te qene te sigurt
and they used to carve from the mountains houses feeling secure
وكانوا ينحتون من الجبال بيوتا ءامنين
e ata ne mengjes i goditi gjemim i tmerrshem e shkaterrues
but the shriek seized them at early morning
فاخذتهم الصيحه مصبحين
dhe nuk u ndihmoi atyre asgje ajo qe vepruan
so nothing availed them from what they used to earn
فما اغني عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون
e ne nuk i krijuam qiejt as token ndryshe vetem me urtesi te madhe e s ka dyshim se momenti i fundit kijameti do te vije e ti muhamme sillu me njerezishmeri
and we have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth and indeed the hour is coming so forgive with gracious forgiveness
وما خلقنا السموت والارض وما بينهما الا بالحق وان الساعه لاتيه فاصفح الصفح الجميل
vertet zoti yt eshte krijuesi i pergjithshem me i dijshmi
indeed your lord he is the knowing creator
ان ربك هو الخلق العليم
ne te kemi dhene ty shtate ajete qe perseriten fatiha perseritet ne rekate te namazit edhe kur anin e madherueshem
and we have certainly given you o muhammad seven of the often repeated verses and the great qur an
ولقد ءاتينك سبع ا من المثاني والقرءان العظيم
e ty te mos shkojne kurrsesi syte ne ate me cka ne i pajisem disa prej tyre as mos u brengos per ta pse nuk besuan kurse ndaj besimtareve jij i perulur e i bute
do not extend your eyes toward that by which we have given enjoyment to certain categories of the disbelievers and do not grieve over them and lower your wing to the believers
لا تمدن عينيك الي ما متعنا به ازوج ا منهم ولا تحزن عليهم واخفض جناحك للمومنين
dhe thuaj une jam qortues i hapet per denimin nga zoti per ata qe kundershtojne
and say indeed i am the clear warner
وقل اني انا النذير المبين
u sjellim denim sikurse u sollem atyre qe bejne ndarjen e librave te mepareshme
just as we had revealed scriptures to the separators
كما انزلنا علي المقتسمين
te cilet e bene kur anin te ndare ne pjese
who have made the qur an into portions
الذين جعلوا القرءان عضين
pasha zotin tend ata gjithe do t i marrim ne pergjegjesi
so by your lord we will surely question them all
فوربك لنسلنهم اجمعين
per ate c vepruan
about what they used to do
عما كانوا يعملون
publiko haptas ate per te cilen urdherohesh e hiqu idhujtareve
then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists
فاصدع بما تومر واعرض عن المشركين
s ka dyshim se ne te mjaftojme ty kunder atyre qe tallen
indeed we are sufficient for you against the mockers
انا كفينك المستهزءين
te cilet all llahut i kundervejne zot tjeter e me vone ata do ta kuptojne prapavine e tyre
who make equal with allah another deity but they are going to know
الذين يجعلون مع الله الها ءاخر فسوف يعلمون
ne e dime mire se ti ngushtohesh shpirterisht per ate qe thone ata
and we already know that your breast is constrained by what they say
ولقد نعلم انك يضيق صدرك بما يقولون
po ti madheroje me falenderime zotin tend e behu prej atyre qe luten perulen duke u falur
so exalt allah with praise of your lord and be of those who prostrate to him
فسبح بحمد ربك وكن من السجدين
dhe adhuroje zotin tend deri te vije ty e verteta vdekja
and worship your lord until there comes to you the certainty death
واعبد ربك حتي ياتيك اليقين
erdhi eshte afruar caktimi i all llahut kijameti pra mos kerkoni ngutje ardhjen para kohes e tij e pster dhe e larte eshte madheria e tij ne krahasimme ate qe ata i shoqerojne shoke
the command of allah is coming so be not impatient for it exalted is he and high above what they associate with him
اتي امر الله فلا تستعجلوه سبحنه وتعلي عما يشركون
me urdherin e tijia zbret engjejt me shpalljen atij qe ai deshiron nga robte e vet duke thene t ua terhiqni verejtjen t i njoftoni se nuk ka te adhuruar zot tjeter vetem une pra te me keni friken
he sends down the angels with the inspiration of his command upon whom he wills of his servants telling them warn that there is no deity except me so fear me
ينزل المليكه بالروح من امره علي من يشاء من عباده ان انذروا انه لا اله الا انا فاتقون
i krijoi qiejt e token me urtesi precize i larte eshte ai nga cka ata idhujtaret i shoqerojne
he created the heavens and earth in truth high is he above what they associate with him
خلق السموت والارض بالحق تعلي عما يشركون
e krijoi njeriun nga nje pikel uji kur qe ai njeriu kundershtar i hapet
he created man from a sperm drop then at once he is a clear adversary
خلق الانسن من نطفه فاذا هو خصيم مبين‏
edhe kafshet ai krijoi dhe ne saje te ketyre ju mund te mbroheni nga te ftohtit keni edhe dobi te tjera dhe prej tyre hani
and the grazing livestock he has created for you in them is warmth and numerous benefits and from them you eat
والانعم خلقها لكم فيها دفء ومنفع ومنها تاكلون
ne to ne kafshet ju shihni hijeshi idili kur ne mbremje ato i ktheni nga kullosa dhe kur ne mengjes i leshoni per ne kullose
and for you in them is the enjoyment of beauty when you bring them in for the evening and when you send them out to pasture
ولكم فيها جمال حين تريحون وحين تسرحون
ato bartin baren tuaj te rende nne ndonje vend te larget qe ju do te arrinit atje me shume veshtiresi me gjysme shpirti vertet zoti juaj eshte shume bamires dhe shume meshirues
and they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves indeed your lord is kind and merciful
وتحمل اثقالكم الي بلد لم تكونوا بلغيه الا بشق الانفس ان ربكم لرءوف رحيم‏
edhe kuajt i krijoi edhe mushkat edhe gomaret per t ju hipur atyre dhe si stoli e ai krijon per hipje cka ju tash nuk dini
and he created the horses mules and donkeys for you to ride and as adornment and he creates that which you do not know
والخيل والبغال والحمير لتركبوها وزينه ويخلق ما لا تعلمون
udhezimi per ne rruge te drejte i takon all llahut e ka edhe rruge qe eshte e shtrember po sikur te kishte deshiruar ai do t u kishte udhezuar qe te gjitheve
and upon allah is the direction of the right way and among the various paths are those deviating and if he willed he could have guided you all
وعلي الله قصد السبيل ومنها جاير ولو شاء لهديكم اجمعين
ai eshte qe per ju leshoi nga lart qielli uje qe prej tij te keni per te piredhe prej tij te keni bime qe ne to do t i kullotni bagetine
it is he who sends down rain from the sky from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture animals
هو الذي انزل من السماء ماء لكم منه شراب ومنه شجر فيه تسيمون
me ate shiun mbijne per te miren tuaj te lashtat ullinjte hurmat rushnajat dhe nga te gjitha frutat e pemeve ne keto te mira ka argumente per nje popull qe veshtron
he causes to grow for you thereby the crops olives palm trees grapevines and from all the fruits indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought
ينبت لكم به الزرع والزيتون والنخيل والاعنب ومن كل الثمرت ان في ذلك لايه لقوم يتفكرون
dhe per ju nenshtroi naten e diten dhe diellin e henen edhe yjet jane te nenshtruar me urdherin e tij vertet ne keto ka argumente per nje popull qe mendon
and he has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon and the stars are subjected by his command indeed in that are signs for a people who reason
وسخر لكم اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر والنجوم مسخرت بامره ان في ذلك لايت لقوم يعقلون
edhe per ate qe ju krijoi ne toke lloje te ndryshme bageti bime peme minerale etj ka fakte per nje popull qe di te merre pervoje
and he has subjected whatever he multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember
وما ذرا لكم في الارض مختلفا الونه ان في ذلك لايه لقوم يذكرون

pastaj ai eshte qe nenshtroi detin qe prej tij te hani mish te fresket e prej tij te nxirrni stoli qe i bani i vishni e i sheh anijet si cajne lundrojne ne te me ushti e e cajne ujin ne det ua nenshtroi qe te shfrytezoni nga begatite e tij dhe ashtu te falenderoni zotin

and it is he who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear and you see the ships plowing through it and he subjected it that you may seek of his bounty and perhaps you will be grateful
وهو الذي سخر البحر لتاكلوا منه لحم ا طري ا وتستخرجوا منه حليه تلبسونها وتري الفلك مواخر فيه ولتبتغوا من فضله ولعلكم تشكرون
dhe ai vuri kodra te forta ne toke ashtu qe ajo te mos lekundet me ju beri edhe lumenj e rruge qe te mund te orientoheni
and he has cast into the earth firmly set mountains lest it shift with you and made rivers and roads that you may be guided
والقي في الارض روسي ان تميد بكم وانهر ا وسبل ا لعلكم تهتدون
vuri edhe shenja te tjera per orientim diten ndersa naten ata orientohen me anen e yjeve
and landmarks and by the stars they are also guided
وعلمت وبالنجم هم يهتدون
atehere pra a eshte ai qe krijon njesoj sikurse ai qe nuk krijon a nuk po mendoni
then is he who creates like one who does not create so will you not be reminded
افمن يخلق كمن لا يخلق افلا تذكرون
po edhe nese perpiqeni t i numeroni dhuntite te mirat e all llahut nuk do te mund te arrini t i percaktoni ato me siguri all llahu shume fal dhe shume meshiron
and if you should count the favors of allah you could not enumerate them indeed allah is forgiving and merciful
وان تعدوا نعمه الله لا تحصوها ان الله لغفور رحيم‏
all llahu e di ate qe ju e fshihni dhe ate qe e publikoni
and allah knows what you conceal and what you declare
والله يعلم ما تسرون وما تعلنون
ata idhujt qe i adhurojne idhujtare pos all llahut ata nuk krijojne asnje send po vete ata jane te krijuar
and those they invoke other than allah create nothing and they themselves are created
والذين يدعون من دون الله لا يخلقون شي ا وهم يخلقون
jane te vdekur e jo te gjalle dhe ata nuk e dine se kur do te ringjallen adhuruesit e tyre
they are in fact dead not alive and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected
اموت غير احياء وما يشعرون ايان يبعثون
zoti juaj qe meriton adhurim eshte nje zot e ata qe nuk e besojne boten tjeter zemrat e tyre jane mohuese te njesise se zotit dhe ata jane kryelarte
your god is one god but those who do not believe in the hereafter their hearts are disapproving and they are arrogant
الهكم اله وحد فالذين لا يومنون بالاخره قلوبهم منكره وهم مستكبرون
eshte e vertete se all llahu e di ate qe e fshehin dhe ate qe e shfaqen haptazi dhe se ai nuk i do arrogantet
